method.window_statistic: For F, B and paired T separately, max over per-rank sample medians
method.variant_statistic: Median of the two window maxima for that variant and scope
method.total: Recorded per-iteration paired F+B samples; never a sum of F/B medians
method.scope: Synchronized NPU Event intervals include Host work/collective stream-idle costs; not pure kernel time
method.exclusions: Input generation, references, reporting, pre-start gradient clearing and loss construction
method.latency_change_percent: (new/old - 1)*100; positive means slower, negative means faster
method.not_pooled: Not PR19's independent complete scope; not a precision result or significance claim
method.publication_scope: Incomplete pilot: 8/24 jobs; only ep4_h3584 has both windows of A/B/C. No cross-machine pooling or completed-matrix claim.

input_audit_policy: Fresh same-input four-shape CPU audit in this runtime; prior-runtime library/input hashes not reused
precision: NOT_RUN: original finite/count smoke gate only
